completeBugReport.title: Login fails on Safari with 2FA enabled
completeBugReport.body:
## Environment
- OS: macOS 12.3
- Browser: Safari 15.4
- Version: 2.1.0

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Enable 2FA
2. Open Safari
3. Navigate to login
4. Enter credentials

## Expected Behavior
Redirected to 2FA screen

## Actual Behavior
500 error displayed

## Definition of Ready
- [ ] Reproducible by team
- [ ] Root cause identified

## Definition of Done
- [ ] Fix deployed
- [ ] Regression tests added
- [ ] Safari 2FA flow re-tested
